## About

I am a microbiologist with academic background in **BSc (2019) and MSc (2020) in Microbiology from Jahangirnagar University** and professional experience in the pharmaceutical industry. I currently work as an **Executive in Quality Control – Microbiology at Aristopharma Ltd.**

Alongside my professional work, I am developing my expertise in **bioinformatics and computational biology**, with a particular interest in high-throughput sequencing data analysis and the molecular mechanisms underlying disease.

## Research Interests

- Single-cell RNA-seq and bulk RNA-seq
- Cancer genomics and transcriptomics
- Gene expression and pathway analysis
- Disease biology and molecular mechanisms
- Tumor–immune interactions
- Computational biology and reproducible research

## Research Direction

I am particularly interested in integrating my **microbiology background with computational approaches** to investigate genomics, disease biology, and cancer research. My long-term goal is to develop interdisciplinary expertise at the intersection of **microbiology, bioinformatics, computational biology, and molecular biology**.
